# Matrix {#sec-matrix}

## Concepts and intutions {.unnumbered}
Matrix is the famous movie by Keanu Reaves.
The appeal to popularity is sometimes frustrating, almost like thinking about Madagascar and people think of lions and zebra.

Like Madagascar existed before, matrix since early age of mathematics.
And in its simple form, it is just a rectangle filled with numbers.

The earliest might be with shopping.
X bought 2 banana, 4 apples and 0 orange
Y bought x banana, 4 apples and 3 orange
Z
A

In short we can condense again this into a matrix
Which one is row or column does not matter as long as we specify which one is row and column.
Shifting is what is called transpose.

## Formal {.unnumbered}
Matrix with row and column,
upper case or bold dimensions, diagonal
Entries or cells lower case
They are mainly numbers.

a vector is a one line or one row matrix

## Tips and warning {.unnumbered}
Matrix is a new object,
Coordinates in a new system
For biologist community matrix is species.
You choose species or sites as coordinates is up to you.

Do not confuse matrix with data frame, although matrix requires same types as entries.
Storing data vs. performing mathematical operation on it.
there are ways to go around but not in this section of the book.

1 x n  is different with n x 1
